ns2:section.sectionText: This section will have distributed classroom attendance with supplemental instruction. You will receive an email with specific attendance directives. Exercise Prescription (3 credits): The application of exercise prescription is complex and requires understanding of anatomy and physiology, exercise prescription and exercise psychology. The major emphasis behind this course will be on connecting theory and practice. Students that complete this course will be prepared to work as personal trainers and to write national certification exams, eg. ACE, NASM, ACSM, if they choose to do so.
